name: Deathguard Samsa
summary: In Tarren Mill, Deathguard Samsa watches the tense frontier and sends travelers against threats near the settlement.

sections.title: Frontier Sentry of Tarren Mill
sections.body: Deathguard Samsa keeps watch in Tarren Mill, where the Forsaken hold their ground in the contested Hillsbrad Foothills. Horde sentries face pressure from Alliance outposts such as Southshore and from savage local wildlife. Samsa guards the perimeter and directs capable adventurers against threats before they endanger the encampment.

faq.answer: Deathguard Samsa serves the Forsaken military in Tarren Mill. He guards the town and directs visiting adventurers to help secure the region from nearby dangers.

faq.q: Where can I find Deathguard Samsa?
faq.answer: Find Deathguard Samsa in Tarren Mill, the major Horde settlement in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What tasks does Deathguard Samsa give out?
faq.answer: Samsa sends adventurers into the Hillsbrad wilderness, including to collect the skulls of Hillsbrad humans slain during the Horde's campaign against them.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know the grim, practical defense needed to hold Lordaeron's southern border against hostile neighbors.
As a Horde traveler in Hillsbrad Foothills, you rely on sentries like Samsa to coordinate defenses against nearby Alliance aggression from Southshore.
